## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass (golden tests within 0.1%)
- [ ] `make npm-build` passes (if `npm/` changed)
- [ ] No real utility data, Pecan Street data or credentials added
- [ ] New source files carry `SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0`
